leakage_found_and_corrected.issue: Original PRIMARY built neighbor cKDTree on FULL 817 cloud -> each test question's LID used train AND test points as neighbors. Representation leakage (NOT target leakage; TwoNN never sees SE). Inconsistent with curvature's train-only-clean standard.
leakage_found_and_corrected.fix: Outer neighbor tree built on TRAIN-ONLY (n=572); all 817 queried against it; self excluded symmetrically so train/test treated identically.

composite_decision.question: Build curvature+LID(+Mahalanobis) composite vs best single feature, pre-reg abort dAUROC>0.03?
composite_decision.rationale: After full audit the viable feature set reduced to curvature alone: eigenscore/effrank are length confounds, LID does not survive leakage-corrected grid evaluation, Mahalanobis never computed. A composite would combine one length-independent feature with confounded/non-surviving features, cannot coherently exceed curvature alone under dAUROC>0.03, and would risk reintroducing the artifacts this paper documents. Reported as considered-and-rejected.
composite_decision.note: When LID briefly looked like a clean +0.12 co-survivor (§16), a curvature+LID composite was tempting; the leakage correction removed that basis. Decision is now evidence-backed.

claim2_mechanism_honesty.established_pattern: On hybrid_SE at the held-out n=245 primary endpoint, curvature's length-partialled SE-signal is CI-CLEAN on EXACTLY ONE cell: SQ-Llama (+0.172 [+0.050,+0.297]). TQA-Llama is CI-MARGINAL (+0.098 [-0.041,+0.228], includes zero). All three Mistral cells null. The earlier 'both Llama cells clean' pattern was an artifact of the stale SE target.
claim2_mechanism_honesty.model_family_NOT_a_clean_boundary: At full-817, curvature is CI-clean on 4/6 cells spanning BOTH models and all three tasks (TQA-L +0.086, SQ-L +0.100, Bio-L +0.087, Bio-M +0.090). Bio-Mistral is clean at full power and sign-flips to -0.011 at held-out. So 'model-bound' holds at NEITHER endpoint alone: full-817 has a clean Mistral cell; held-out has only 1/3 Llama cells clean. Asserting 'model-bound' requires splicing the Llama-half of full-817 with the Mistral-half of held-out.
claim2_mechanism_honesty.reframe: C2 ('model-bound') RETIRED as a standalone headline (20260626 decision). Folded into C4: curvature is the cleanest endpoint-determines-verdict instance — same feature, same target, same controls; only the eval split changes and the survivor set moves from 4 cells (full-817) to 1 (held-out).
claim2_mechanism_honesty.robust_cell: SQ-Llama is the sole cell positive AND CI-clean at BOTH endpoints (full +0.100, held-out +0.172, strengthens on held-out). Report as the one genuinely robust curvature-SE result; do not generalize it to a model boundary.
claim2_mechanism_honesty.mechanism_NOT_established: We do NOT know WHY SQ-Llama specifically is the robust cell. Three competing explanations remain indistinguishable — enumerate, do not pick:

competing_hypotheses.H1_target_compression: Mistral SE more compressed (higher zero-mass) -> less SE variance for any feature to track. Confounded with model family; raise as hypothesis only.
competing_hypotheses.H2_representational_geometry: Llama vs Mistral organize trajectory geometry differently; curvature over the 0->16 window may not capture the analogous structure in Mistral. Layer sweep is LLAMA-ONLY — cannot distinguish 'no signal' from 'signal in an untested window'.
competing_hypotheses.H3_underpowered_noise: Held-out n=245 has a detection floor. TQA/Bio Llama cells are clean at full-817 but not held-out; the effect may sit below the n=245 floor on several cells. Consistent with 'endpoint/power determines verdict' (C4).

claim2_mechanism_honesty.honest_writeup_sentence: At the held-out endpoint, curvature's SE-association is CI-clean on a single cell (SQ-Llama); across the grid the apparent transfer pattern is governed by evaluation design (full-817 vs held-out), not by model family.
